address: 75-1 Wenhua Road, Jiaxian District, Kaohsiung, Taiwan
bio: Adjacent to a water park in an area famous for taro and bamboo shoots, this restaurant has been serving game meats and wild greens since 1971. Signatures include wild boar, muntjac, spotted dove, giant mottled eel, wild fish and shrimps. Braised pork belly with taro and shredded bamboo shoot, and turmeric chicken are also worth trying. Round it out with deep-fried taro balls, and the complimentary taro ice cubes.
